Because the emptiness of the own-being of non-entities is the emptiness of emptiness, the bodhisattva is not apprehended at the later limit. Because the emptiness of the own-being of non-entities is isolated, the bodhisattva is not apprehended at the later limit. Because non-entities are nonexistent as the emptiness of own-being, [and] because the emptiness of the own-being of existents is without own-being, the bodhisattva is not apprehended at the later limit. Because the emptiness of the own-being of non-entities is isolated, the bodhisattva is not apprehended in the middle. The bodhisattva is not apprehended in the middle. The bodhisattva [unclear] of the three is apprehended. The bodhisattva is not apprehended in the middle. Because the own-being of non-entities is the emptiness of emptiness, the bodhisattva is not apprehended in the middle. Why is that? Venerable Śāriputra, in the emptiness of the own-being of non-entities being nonexistent, in the emptiness of the own-being of non-entities being the emptiness of emptiness, in the emptiness of the own-being of non-entities being isolated, and in the emptiness of the own-being of non-entities being without own-being, the prior limit is not apprehended.
